loggex.title: Loggex Machina
loggex.subtitle: Academic Management Platform
loggex.description: A multi-tenant SaaS platform for comprehensive school management. Covers the full academic cycle: enrolment, constraint-based timetabling, attendance, assignments, grading and real-time messaging. Built with Symfony 8 + React 19, deployed on Docker with S3 storage, async job queue and an official BOE catalogue of 230 programmes and ~2,230 subjects.
loggex.highlights: 37 entities · Multi-tenant per centre · Scheduling engine with custom solvers · Real-time with Mercure SSE · Official BOE catalogue (230 programmes, ~2,230 subjects) · Dynamic theming (80+ CSS vars/centre) · 5 languages · Async jobs with Redis · Roles: Superadmin, Admin, Teacher, Student · PDF export
loggex.modules: Centre · Programmes & subjects · Groups & enrolment · Schedule editor · Teaching periods · Attendance · Tasks & assignments · Grading · Syllabi · Messaging · Announcements · Notifications · Official catalogue

dexter.title: Project Dexter
dexter.subtitle: Pokémon App for Trainers
dexter.description: Native Android Pokédex powered by PokéAPI v2 with Spanish descriptions via WikiDex scraping. Browse ~1,000 Pokémon by generation (I-IX) with type, form and rarity filters; view full detail sheets covering stats, moves, evolutions, encounters and type effectiveness; explore ~900 moves and ~1,000 items. Features Pokémon identification via device camera using Google Gemini Vision AI.
dexter.highlights: Pokédex 9 generations (I-IX) · Camera identification (Gemini AI) · 9-tab detail sheet · Filter by type, form & rarity · ~900 moves · ~1,000+ items & berries · 10 regions · WikiDex scraping · Type animated backgrounds · 3-level cache · Shared element transitions
